tables.Tapping this icon displays information a: Tapping this icon begins upgrading the Wizard Tower to the next level, if you have enough resources and a free Builder (or B.O.B ). When the Wizard Tower is at maximum level, this icon is not shown.

Tapping this icon instantly upgrades the Wizard Tower to the next level, at the cost of one Hammer of Building if you have one. When the Wizard Tower is at maximum level, or if the Town Hall requirements for the next level are not met, this icon is not shown.
Tapping this icon, which is displayed only while an upgrade is in progress, instantly finishes that upgrade at the cost of the displayed number of Gems .

Tapping this icon, which is displayed only while an upgrade is in progress, instantly finishes that upgrade at the cost of one Book of Building . This icon is only shown if you have at least one Book of Building.

Tapping this icon, which is displayed only while an upgrade is in progress, instantly finishes that upgrade at the cost of one Book of Everything . This icon is only shown if you have at least one Book of Everything but do not have a Book of Building.

Tapping this icon, which is displayed only while an upgrade is in progress, gives the player the option to assign a Builder's Apprentice to that Building. This icon only is only shown if you have unlocked Builder's Apprentice for 500 Gems .

Tapping this icon, which is displayed only while an upgrade is in progress, boosts all your Builders for 1 hour by a factor of ten, at the cost of one Builder Potion . This icon is only shown if you have at least one Builder Potion.
Tapping this icon, which is displayed only while an upgrade is in progress, cancels the current upgrade and refunds half of the upgrade cost.

tables.Type: The Wizard Tower was present in the original release of the game, with six levels and two of them to unlock.

tables.Description: The Wizard Tower's attack gained a new visual effect.
Added the third Wizard Tower available at Town Hall 8. Improved visual effects.
Added the level 7 Wizard Tower. Gave the Wizard atop the tower upgrade differences at higher levels.
Added the fourth Wizard Tower available at Town Hall 9. Made it so that Wizard Towers do not restart their attack cycle if their would-be target is destroyed, instead they switch targets.
Added the level 8 Wizard Tower.
Reduced upgrade time for most Wizard Tower levels.
Reduced hitpoints at levels 2 to 8 (except 7).
Allowed its range to be visible even when under construction. Wizard Towers now initially point away from the Town Hall in combat.
Increased hitpoints at levels 4 to 8.
Added the level 9 Wizard Tower. Added the fifth Wizard Tower available at Town Hall 11.
Increased hitpoints of levels 5 to 9.
Reduced upgrade costs at levels 7 and 8: Level 7: 5,360,000 to 4,500,000. Level 8: 6,480,000 to 6,000,000.
Added the level 10 Wizard Tower. Moved level 9 Wizard Tower to Town Hall 10. Reduced upgrade costs at level 4 to 9. Reduced upgrade times at level 7 to 9.
Reduced damage at level 9 from 56 to 54.
Added the level 11 Wizard Tower. The Wizard atop the level 7 Wizard Tower now has level 6 design instead of level 5. This was suggested by a user on Reddit on October 6, 2016 .
Reduced upgrade times at levels 1 to 10.
Reduced upgrade times at levels 1 to 9. Reduced upgrade costs at levels 7 to 9.
Added the level 12 Wizard Tower.
Added the level 13 Wizard Tower.

Reduced upgrade times and costs at levels 3 to 10 (except 9). The level 14 Wizard Tower appeared in the official Jungle Warden trailer for the May 2021 season, added as an easter egg by Supercell. This level was later added into the June 15 2021 update.
Added the level 14 Wizard Tower.
Reduced upgrade costs at all levels except 7.
Added the level 15 Wizard Tower.
Changed the texture at levels 1 to 5.
Added the level 16 Wizard Tower. Reduced upgrade costs and times of levels 2 to 15.

The Wizard Tower's attack gains a new visual effect, with the fireballs changing their color depending on its level.
